comments.author: nomorebuttsplz
comments.body: is there a prompt + environment? like do you tell the model to use any particular approach or tools?

replies.author: SIMMORSAL
replies.body:
Setup:
- Fresh Blender install + "Blender MCP" extrnsion set up in it
- opencode + Qwen 3.8 27b Q4 + Blender MCP added to it

Prompt:
"You have access to blender, model and animate a running cheetah. Add textures to it as well"

No other reference. It one shotted the model above, and then I asked it to export the two videos
